title: 线上体育博彩用户行为追踪：活跃少数贡献多数营收
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Sports betting is everywhere, especially among American men.
segments.zh: 体育博彩无处不在，尤其是在美国男性中。

segments.en: More than half of men 18 to 49 years old bet on sports.
segments.zh: 18至49岁的男性中，超过一半参与体育博彩。

segments.en: It's so easy to bet on sports from your phone, it has raised concerns that problem gambling is on the rise.
segments.zh: 手机下注太容易，引发问题赌博上升的担忧。

segments.en: To investigate this, we used anonymized credit and debit card information of more than 20 million users from Bloomberg's second measure
segments.zh: 为调查此事，我们使用了彭博第二测量公司超过2000万用户的匿名信用卡和借记卡信息。

segments.en: to see every time a group of more than 2400 Massachusetts betters deposited money into their sports book accounts.
segments.zh: 以查看2400多名马萨诸塞州投注者每次向体育博彩账户存款的情况。

segments.en: We looked at more than three years of data since online betting was legalized there in 2023.
segments.zh: 我们分析了自2023年当地在线博彩合法化以来三年多的数据。

segments.en: We found the sports books claim that most people are casual bettors is, in fact, true.
segments.zh: 我们发现，体育博彩公司声称大多数人只是休闲投注者，这确实属实。

segments.en: But the least active two thirds of sports book users account for less than 3% of estimated gross revenue.
segments.zh: 但最不活跃的三分之二用户仅占估计总收入的不到3%。

segments.en: That means the more active minority is far more profitable for these apps.
segments.zh: 这意味着更活跃的少数用户对这些应用来说利润要高得多。

segments.en: Without the people who deposit into the sports book apps nearly every day, digital sports books would lose approximately 60% of their gross revenue are analysis found.
segments.zh: 分析发现，如果没有几乎每天向体育博彩应用存款的人，数字体育博彩将损失约60%的总收入。

segments.en: We also found evidence among our cohort to suggest behavior indicative of problem gambling is on the rise.
segments.zh: 我们还在样本中发现证据表明，问题赌博行为呈上升趋势。

segments.en: Of the people who make deposits into sports books monthly, one in five will eventually do so daily.
segments.zh: 在每月向体育博彩存款的人中，五分之一最终会每天存款。

segments.en: The behaviors of this cohort are those of men at risk.
segments.zh: 这一群体的行为属于高风险男性的行为。

segments.en: They risk having less money safe for retirement.
segments.zh: 他们面临退休安全资金减少的风险。
